channel.title: Orchard
channel.description: Apple news, rumors and iPhone Duo apps, each with its source. An independent site, not affiliated with Apple.

item.title: iFixit teardown: HomeView is needlessly hard to repair
item.description: iFixit found strong glue holding the display, speakers and logic board, and one speaker snapped while being removed. The logic board is bonded to the aluminum shell, which works as a heat sink, so it took real force to free. The tabletop and wall-mounted models are built differently inside and…

item.title: App Store prices change in five countries, and California adds tax on some apps
item.description: Apple told developers that new taxes now apply in Botswana (14% VAT), Rwanda (18% VAT), Cameroon and Côte d'Ivoire (3% digital tax each). On 3 December App Store prices will be adjusted in Botswana, Colombia, Egypt, Rwanda and Türkiye; auto-renewing subscriptions and manually set prices are not…

item.title: Final Cut Pro gets MotionVFX effects for Creator Studio subscribers
item.description: Apple is updating Final Cut Pro with the templates, titles, transitions and effects from MotionVFX, a company it bought earlier this year. The update adds 3D titles that follow camera movement, better masking, a way to animate still images, a Content Hub with stock media, text-to-image generation…

item.title: iOS 27.3's new Health app needs an iPhone 15 Pro or later
item.description: The redesigned Health app in iOS 27.3 relies on Apple Intelligence, so 9to5Mac reports it needs an iPhone 15 Pro or newer with Apple Intelligence turned on. On older iPhones the Health app will look mostly the same. The new features also start in only some languages. iOS 27.3 is expected next month.

item.title: UK iCloud+ plans won't raise Siri AI limits
item.description: Apple's support page on the new daily limits for Siri AI and other server-based Apple Intelligence features says most iCloud+ plans raise those limits at no extra cost, but not in the UK. It is not yet clear whether UK users will have another way to get more use. The limits start with iOS 27.3.

item.title: Epic says Apple is holding back 122,000 documents on its fee plans
item.description: In the US District Court case over App Store link-outs, Epic told the court that Apple produced 632 documents matching agreed search terms but withheld more than 122,000 others as not relevant. Epic wants all non-privileged matches handed over by 2 December, with a daily fine for each day after…

item.title: Morgan Stanley expects iPhone to gain share in a shrinking 2027 market
item.description: A Morgan Stanley report forecasts about 270 million iPhone shipments in 2027, up 7%, while overall smartphone shipments fall 5%. That would give Apple about 26% of the market. The bank notes some of the gain may simply be sales moving into 2027, since the iPhone 18 and 18e are expected in spring.…

item.title: Apple Account sign-in, App Store and Apple Store systems go down
item.description: On the morning of 17 November many Apple services stopped working. People could not sign in to their Apple Account, were signed out of iCloud, or could not download apps. Apple Music, Apple Pay, iPhone activation and App Store Connect were also hit, and Apple's own retail stores could not complete…

item.title: Apple now sells iPhone Duo repair parts for DIY fixes
item.description: iPhone Duo parts and tools are now on Apple's Self Service Repair Store in the US, Canada and Europe. The parts list covers both displays, both batteries, the back glass, cameras, speakers, the logic board, the Touch ID and Camera Control part, the USB-C port and more. Tools such as suction cups,…

item.title: Apple Store app is now optimized for iPhone Duo
item.description: Apple's own shopping app has been updated for iPhone Duo. It now fills both the inner and outer screens in any orientation, moves to a single tab bar at the bottom, and has a slightly refreshed icon. It had been one of the few Apple apps still missing Duo support.

item.title: Report: Apple pushed an iPhone Duo supplier to pull its statement on screen cracks
item.description: Korea's The Elec says Apple pressured Fine M-Tec, which reportedly makes the metal plates that support the Duo's folding screen, to take down a statement. On 26 October the company had said the screen problems were not caused by its parts; the statement was gone from its website by 4 November. A…

item.title: Apple starts work on better dual SIM support for apps in the EU
item.description: Apple has moved a developer's EU interoperability request into its build phase. The request asks that calling and contacts apps be able to read the names you give your lines (such as Work and Personal), read and set the preferred line for each contact, and show which line a call used. It does not…

item.title: Hidden iOS 27.3 setting softens the edge of Liquid Glass bars
item.description: Code explorer pdfu found a disabled feature in iOS 27.3 beta 2 that makes content fade gently under the top navigation bar, instead of stopping at a hard edge. It is closer to how iOS 26 looked. It reportedly applies only to standard navigation bars when the Liquid Glass tint is low. Apple hasn't…

item.title: Apple said to be close to a multi-year memory deal with Samsung
item.description: Korea's Maeil Business Newspaper reports that Apple is close to signing a four- to five-year DRAM supply deal with Samsung, starting in the first half of 2027. It would guarantee a minimum supply, with prices set later. Apple usually prefers short contracts, but it reportedly signed a similar deal…

item.title: iPhone Duo can tell when you are looking at it in iOS 27.3 beta 2
item.description: 9to5Mac reports that the second iOS 27.3 beta brings attention-aware features to iPhone Duo. Until now these needed Face ID. The phone checks whether you are looking at the outer screen before it dims the display, and it lowers the volume of alarms, timers and incoming calls while you look at it.…

item.title: New iPhone Duo orders now arrive before the holidays
item.description: Apple's US online store now shows delivery on 16 to 23 December for new iPhone Duo orders, in every color and storage size. Until now new orders showed late January. MacRumors readers with January dates say most were moved to 14 to 21 December. 9to5Mac says the earlier dates also show outside the…

item.title: Corey Fugman is said to be the new head of Apple Pay and Wallet
item.description: Bloomberg reports, citing people familiar with the matter, that Apple has picked 26-year veteran Corey Fugman to run Apple Pay and Wallet, replacing Jennifer Bailey, who has led Apple Pay since it launched in 2014. Bailey is said to stay on as a consultant in the coming months. 9to5Mac notes that…

item.title: tvOS 27.3 beta 2 turns on Siri AI for Apple TV testers
item.description: The first tvOS 27.3 beta left Siri AI out. The second adds a setup screen that offers to switch it on, or to keep the older Siri. Siri AI on Apple TV needs a paired device nearby that also has Siri AI turned on. HomePod mini 2 is still waiting for it.

item.title: Siri AI can answer questions about your Health data in iOS 27.3 beta 2
item.description: Until now Siri AI refused Health questions, though the older Siri could answer them. In the second beta it can report things like recent steps, heart rate readings and Activity ring progress, log medications, and show the answer on a card styled like the Health app. MacRumors says it reads Health…

item.title: Apple Intelligence reaches iPad and Mac in China in the 27.3 betas
item.description: The second iPadOS 27.3 and macOS 27.3 betas let developers in China test Apple Intelligence on iPad and Mac. The first beta offered it only on iPhone. MacRumors lists Macs and iPads with M-series chips, plus iPad mini with A17 Pro or A20 Pro. Features include Live Translation, Writing Tools,…

item.title: Apple News+ puzzles are coming to the UK, Australia and French Canada
item.description: The 27.3 betas bring Apple News+ puzzles to three more audiences. Australia gets the quick crossword, crossword mini, Sudoku, Quartiles and Emoji Game. The UK gets the quick crossword, crossword mini and Sudoku. French-language readers in Canada get Quartiles and Emoji Game. Until now puzzles were…

item.title: Apple marks Pokémon's 30th anniversary with wallpapers and a gift card in Japan
item.description: Apple released a set of original Pokémon wallpapers for iPhone, including one sized for iPhone Duo. Several feature Applin, the apple-shaped Pokémon. Until 30 November, Apple Stores in Japan sell a special Applin gift card (limit three per customer) and serve as PokéStops in Pokémon GO.

item.title: iOS 27.3 beta 2 lets iPhone Duo unlock with your face
item.description: The second iOS 27.3 beta adds a face unlock option for iPhone Duo, switched on in Settings under Touch ID & Passcode. It uses the front camera on the outer screen, so it works only when the phone is closed. This is not Face ID: it only unlocks the phone, while Apple Pay, passwords and app sign-ins…

item.title: Apple says more than 200,000 apps are now optimized for iPhone Duo
item.description: Apple marketing chief Greg Joswiak shared the new figure on X. It has doubled from the 100,000 Apple gave earlier this month. MacRumors says the count covers apps built with the iOS 27.1 SDK or later, which fill both Duo screens.

item.title: iOS 27.3 beta 2 is out, with Siri AI that can read a whole web page
item.description: Apple released second developer betas of iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3, macOS 27.3, watchOS 27.3, tvOS 27.3 and visionOS 27.3, two weeks after the first. New in Safari is 'Ask About Page': Siri AI can read a full web page, including parts that aren't on screen, and answer questions about it. Apple also…

item.title: Siri AI gets daily limits, and bigger iCloud+ plans raise them
item.description: With the 27.3 betas, Apple has explained how usage limits work for AI features that run on its servers. Each iPhone, iPad and Mac gets its own free daily allowance, which resets around midnight local time and doesn't roll over. Simple Siri requests such as timers stay unlimited. The limits cover…

item.title: macOS 27.3 beta tightens Full Disk Access and app control
item.description: The macOS 27.3 beta brings the privacy changes Apple promised in October. The single 'Device Control and Data Access' switch is split in two: Accessibility, for assistive tools, and 'System and App Protection Override', for apps that automate or control other apps. You can pick which apps an…

item.title: Apple starts a US study on using AI for health questions
item.description: The Apple Health AI Usage Study looks at how much people trust and understand answers from a health chatbot, and what they do with them. It is open to up to 200,000 people aged 21 or older in the US with an iPhone 15 Pro or later on iOS 26 or later, through the Apple Health AI Study app. Answers…

item.title: HomeView owners report timer, Siri and music problems
item.description: Days after launch, owners on the MacRumors forums describe several faults. Some units refuse to set timers or alarms and say a software update is needed even when none is available. Others report Siri taking minutes to answer, music requests failing or playing on the iPhone instead, and homes with…

item.title: Some OLED MacBook Pro owners report eye strain and headaches
item.description: Owners of the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display are posting on Reddit, X and the MacRumors forums about eye strain, headaches, dizziness and nausea. The likely cause is the way the OLED panel dims by flickering (PWM). Notebookcheck measured 240Hz flicker on the 14-inch model at any brightness…

item.title: Tabletop HomeView orders now slip to late December or January
item.description: On Apple's US online store, new orders of the tabletop HomeView show delivery on 16 to 23 December for Silver and Space Gray, 23 December to 5 January for Starlight, and 5 to 12 January for Rose Pink. The wall-mounted version can still arrive the next day. MacRumors says Apple Stores and resellers…

item.title: Apple.com is now available in Spanish in the US
item.description: Most of Apple's US website can now be read in Spanish at apple.com/us-es, or by picking Spanish in the language menu at the bottom of the site. The online store and Financial Services pages stay in English for now; Spanish speakers who want to shop are pointed to an Apple Specialist by phone.

item.title: Apple says Canada's Bill C-22 would still weaken user data protection
item.description: Bill C-22 would let Canada's government require companies to build tools that help police and intelligence agencies reach user data, and make some providers keep connection records for up to six months. Lawmakers added limits on forced decryption. Apple told Bloomberg it welcomes those revisions…

item.title: New Apple TV 4K's A19 runs with one core off, and apps are capped at 2GB of memory
item.description: Diagnostic data shared on X by the code researcher pdfu shows the A19 in the new Apple TV 4K running five CPU cores (two performance, three efficiency), one efficiency core fewer than the same chip in iPhone 17. Apple did something similar with the A15 in the 2022 model. Separately, 9to5Mac says…

item.title: iPhone 20 Pro leaks: iPhone Air glass curved on four sides, and a new camera sensor
item.description: Two Weibo leakers posted about next year's 20th-anniversary iPhone Pro. Fixed Focus Digital says it will use the same glass material as iPhone Air, shaped with more curve on all four sides. Ice Universe says the main camera sensor will use logic circuitry made on a new 17-nanometer process,…

item.title: Apple smart glasses may be shown at WWDC in June 2027
item.description: Mark Gurman reports that Apple plans to unveil its first smart glasses at WWDC next June and ship them before the end of 2027. The first model is said to have no display. You talk to Siri, which uses built-in cameras to answer questions about what you are looking at, and it handles calls,…

item.title: Face ID may not be ready in time for iPhone Duo 2
item.description: Mark Gurman says Apple has four goals for future Duo models: Face ID, an Action button, a telephoto camera and a thinner, lighter body. Face ID comes first. Apple has built Duo 2 prototypes with it in the outer display and engineers are still working on it, but time is short, and it could slip to…

item.title: Gurman's 2027 list: more than 15 new Apple products
item.description: In his Power On newsletter, Mark Gurman lists what he expects from Apple next year: smart glasses, a redesigned iPhone Pro line, iPhone Duo 2, iPhone Air 2, iPhone 18 and 18e; major updates to the entry-level iPad, iPad Air and iPad Pro; a rethought Apple Watch; MacBook Pros with M7, M7 Pro and M7…

item.title: tvOS 27.2.1 is out; HomePod mini 2 still waits for Siri AI
item.description: tvOS 27.2.1 brings Siri AI to the second- and third-generation Apple TV 4K. It is opt-in: go to Settings > General > Siri > Siri AI (Beta) to start the download, otherwise the older Siri stays. The update also includes security fixes. HomePod software 27.2.1 arrived the same day with bug fixes…

item.title: CNET's iPhone Duo fold test passes 450,000 folds, and the hinge is loosening
item.description: After three weeks on CNET's folding machine, the test Duo has passed 451,000 folds and still works, with no cracks reported. CNET says the hinge began to feel looser at about 390,000 folds. At about 440,300 the opening action weakened, and the screen now stops 5 to 10 degrees short of flat in the…
